== Biography ==

Five is one of three gardeners in the Queen's garden, engaged in the curious task of repainting white roses red. A character of sulky disposition, he is quick to deflect blame for his own mishaps. When warned by a companion against splashing paint during his labour, Five protested that he could not help it, insisting that Seven had jogged his elbow and caused the accident. Seven, observing this pattern of excuse-making, remarked pointedly that Five was always inclined to lay the blame on others rather than himself.

== Relationships ==

'''[[Seven]]''' — friendly_rivalry. Five and Seven work in close proximity; their interactions suggest frequent mutual blame and defensiveness between them.

'''[[Alice]]''' — ally. Alice encounters Five while observing the gardeners at their task.

'''[[Queen]]''' — enemy. Five appears to serve under the Queen's authority in the royal garden.
